key.name: session-key
key.description: OAuth token for fetching usage data. Auto-detected from ~/.claude/.credentials.json if empty.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to fetch updated usage data

key.name: position-in-panel
key.description: Where to place the indicator: left, center, or right

key.name: enable-claude
key.description: Show the Claude (Anthropic) usage segment, fetched from api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage.

key.name: enable-codex
key.description: Show live Codex usage from Codex App Server, with a local rollout snapshot as a legacy fallback.
